jobs.title: Join Our Talent Network
jobs.descriptionHtml:
P2P.org is the largest institutional staking provider with a TVL of over $10B and a market share exceeding 20% in restaking.

We are continually focused on researching and improving our infrastructure to extract maximum APR while enhancing security. For instance, in ETH and SOL, our NRR is on average 10% higher than the market, and in DOT, it's 20% higher.

We also place significant focus and resources on launching new networks such as TON, Avail, Monad, Babylon, Story, Berachain, and others, along with yield products. From restaking, where we are the largest operator with a 20+% market share, to yield aggregators on stablecoins.

Our clients include BitGo, Copper, Crypto.com, Ledger, ByBit, Bitget, OKX, HTX, Bitvavo, SBI, and others, who choose us for our client-centric approach and extensive product line from unified API to widgets and custom dApps.

We are also actively expanding our product line, exploring RWA, data, yield, and service products for banks, exchanges, custodians, and wallets.

P2P.org unites talented individuals globally.

Despite our distributed team, we share a passion for decentralized finance - a fairer system for all. We code, learn, create, and connect to shape finance's future.

P2P.org boasts a strong reputation and network. We prioritize customer satisfaction and, as tech enthusiasts, develop innovative solutions that bolster our brand.

Can’t find the perfect role just yet? Let’s stay connected.

At P2P.org, we believe exceptional talent shouldn't have to wait for the right job posting to make a move. If you're passionate about what you do and excited about the future of decentralized technologies, we want to hear from you—even if there isn’t a current vacancy that fits your profile.

That’s why we’ve created our Spontaneous Recruitment Program—a gateway for driven, curious, and innovative professionals to join our Talent Community.

By submitting your resume today, you’ll become part of our exclusive talent pool. Our recruitment team will keep your profile on the radar and reach out directly when a role opens that aligns with your background, passions, and goals.

Why join our Talent Community?

  • Stay in the loop with future opportunities across different teams and specialties.

  • Be top of mind when new roles open, even before they go public.

  • Keep the door open to possibilities that align with your interests and career goals.

  • Build a lasting connection with a team that’s always on the lookout for great people.

Whether you’re actively looking or simply open to future opportunities, your next big move could be closer than you think.

Share your story. Let’s explore what’s possible—together.

At P2P.org we have a team of experts with their own unique approach and ownership culture. Together we gain experience and make dreams come true!

  • Fully remote

  • Full-time contractor (Indefinite-term Consultancy Agreement)

  • Competitive salary level in $ (we can also pay in crypto)

  • Paid vacation and sick leave

  • Well-being program

  • Mental Health care program

  • Compensation for education, including foreign language & professional growth courses

  • Equipment & co-working reimbursement program

  • Overseas conferences, community immersion

P2P.org is committed to providing equal opportunities. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
P2P.org is the largest institutional staking provider with a TVL of over $10B and a market share exceeding 20% in restaking.

We are continually focused on researching and improving our infrastructure to extract maximum APR while enhancing security. For instance, in ETH and SOL, our NRR is on average 10% higher than the market, and in DOT, it's 20% higher.

We also place significant focus and resources on launching new networks such as TON, Avail, Monad, Babylon, Story, Berachain, and others, along with yield products. From restaking, where we are the largest operator with a 20+% market share, to yield aggregators on stablecoins.

Our clients include BitGo, Copper, Crypto.com, Ledger, ByBit, Bitget, OKX, HTX, Bitvavo, SBI, and others, who choose us for our client-centric approach and extensive product line from unified API to widgets and custom dApps.

We are also actively expanding our product line, exploring RWA, data, yield, and service products for banks, exchanges, custodians, and wallets.

P2P.org unites talented individuals globally.

Despite our distributed team, we share a passion for decentralized finance - a fairer system for all. We code, learn, create, and connect to shape finance's future.

P2P.org boasts a strong reputation and network. We prioritize customer satisfaction and, as tech enthusiasts, develop innovative solutions that bolster our brand.

Responsibilities

  • Turn marketing priorities into plans with clear budgets, timelines and success metrics.

  • Own execution and personally run campaigns in your strongest channels, using LLMs and automation.

  • Manage contractors and internal contributors: set priorities, write briefs, review work and address underperformance.

  • Coordinate with Product and Sales to clarify requirements and resolve blockers.

  • Track spend, lead quality and pipeline contribution. Recommend what to improve, scale or stop.

  • Identify where specialist contractors are needed and manage their delivery.

Requirements

  • Strong execution skills in at least one marketing channel, with verifiable examples of campaigns you personally ran and results you achieved. We welcome different channel specializations.

  • At least 4 years of substantive marketing experience, including independently owning B2B marketing initiatives. Be ready to explain your contribution, decisions and measurable results.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including influencing without formal authority and challenging requests constructively.

  • Experience managing contractors or agencies and leading people or small teams.

  • Solid marketing fundamentals: tracking, segmentation, positioning, messaging, channel selection and conversion funnels.

  • Practical analytical skills: interpreting campaign and CRM data, assessing acquisition economics and understanding attribution limitations.

  • Regular use of LLMs in marketing work, with sound judgment when reviewing their output.

  • Ability to prioritize and deliver with limited supervision, learn complex products and make informed budget decisions.

  • Strong written and spoken English.

jobs.title: Product Designer (new product)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
P2P.org is the largest institutional staking provider with a TVL of over $10B and a market share exceeding 20% in restaking.

We are continually focused on researching and improving our infrastructure to extract maximum APR while enhancing security. For instance, in ETH and SOL, our NRR is on average 10% higher than the market, and in DOT, it's 20% higher.

We also place significant focus and resources on launching new networks such as TON, Avail, Monad, Babylon, Story, Berachain, and others, along with yield products. From restaking, where we are the largest operator with a 20+% market share, to yield aggregators on stablecoins.

Our clients include BitGo, Copper, Crypto.com, Ledger, ByBit, Bitget, OKX, HTX, Bitvavo, SBI, and others, who choose us for our client-centric approach and extensive product line from unified API to widgets and custom dApps.

We are also actively expanding our product line, exploring RWA, data, yield, and service products for banks, exchanges, custodians, and wallets.

P2P.org unites talented individuals globally.

Despite our distributed team, we share a passion for decentralized finance - a fairer system for all. We code, learn, create, and connect to shape finance's future.

P2P.org boasts a strong reputation and network. We prioritize customer satisfaction and, as tech enthusiasts, develop innovative solutions that bolster our brand.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prediction market & trading terminal design: Design intuitive, high-performance trading interfaces, including dashboards, charts, order books, and trading workflows.

  • Web & App Design: Own the end-to-end UI/UX design of web and mobile applications, from initial concepts and wireframes to polished, production-ready interfaces.

  • Social Media & Marketing Creatives: Create engaging visuals for social media, marketing campaigns, product launches, and other promotional materials.

  • Design System: Build and maintain a consistent visual identity and scalable design system across all digital products.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with founders, product managers, and developers to translate business requirements into effective design solutions.

  • Design Ownership: Take full ownership of design decisions, present and justify your solutions, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and continuously improve the user experience.

At P2P.org we have a team of experts with their own unique approach and ownership culture. Together we gain experience and make dreams come true!

  • Fully remote

  • Full-time contractor (Indefinite-term Consultancy Agreement)

  • Competitive salary level in $ (we can also pay in crypto)

  • Paid vacation and sick leave

  • Well-being program

  • Mental Health care program

  • Compensation for education, including foreign language & professional growth courses

  • Equipment & co-working reimbursement program

  • Overseas conferences, community immersion

P2P.org is committed to providing equal opportunities. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or disability.
